children: Raising taxes in Russia is not currently under discussion, the Kremlin said on Wednesday, the same day that authorities reported a narrowing budget deficit.

The finance ministry, citing preliminary data, said Russia's budget deficit narrowed to 5.8 trillion roubles ($67.8 billion), or 2.5% of gross domestic product, in the first eight months of the year, from 6.46 trillion roubles, or 2.8% of GDP, a month earlier.
